_about: Public-domain John Richardson Illingworth (1848-1915, Anglican philosophical theologian of the Lux Mundi circle) for the Word Hoard: 9 books from Internet Archive scans, among them Personality Human and Divine (Bampton Lectures, 1894), Divine Immanence (1898), Reason and Revelation (1902), The Doctrine of the Trinity (1907) and Divine Transcendence (1911). Written in English. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 27 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
